summary: Gamehaus Holdings Inc., a Cayman-incorporated China-based issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing an At The Market Offering Agreement dated November 10, 2026 with ARC Group Securities LLC as sales agent for up to US$11,642,197 of Class A ordinary shares. Sales occur under an effective Form F-3 shelf (File No. 333-297738) via Rule 415(a)(4) at-the-market methods on Nasdaq, subject to the one-third non-affiliate float cap under General Instruction I.B.5. Agent compensation is 3.0% of gross proceeds. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and any acceleration in share sales.
